WorldSave.title: WorldSave
WorldSave.description: Persistent cloud save storing a player's world builds, chests, interactive objects, and player inventory across game updates.

ownerId.description: The authenticated Firebase UID of the player who owns this save.

worldId.description: Unique identifier for the world or server lobby.

worldName.description: Display name or lobby code of the world.

time.description: Current normalized time of day (0 to 1).

inventoryCounts.description: Map of item types to counts in the player's inventory.

slotOrder.description: Ordered list of item types in the player's inventory slots (up to 36 slots).

modifiedBlocksMap.description: Map of block coordinates ('x,y') to TileType numbers representing player builds and mined terrain.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this save was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when this save was last updated.

/users/{userId}/worldSaves/{worldId}.description: Stores per-user persistent world builds and player inventory snapshots.
